2.question: Are you affiliated with Google LLC?

Digital goods are non-refundable after credentials are delivered. If Google suspends an account under their own terms, that is beyond our warranty. 24/7 help via Telegram.

5.question: How can I pay? Is it safe?
5.answer: We support MoMo, ZaloPay, VietQR, and bank transfer. Transactions use encrypted checkout. One-time payment — no auto-renew from us. We do not store your card numbers.

6.question: How long until delivery?
6.answer: Usually 1–5 minutes after successful payment. During peak hours it may take a bit longer. You get an email with login steps for Google AI.
